guards.title: Intent correlation
guards.negativeControl: Duplicate notification then identical legitimate insertion must yield exactly two intents.

guards.title: Atomic compound edits
guards.negativeControl: Final prepare failure must expose zero mutations, updates and history changes.

guards.title: Resulting selection
guards.negativeControl: Corrupt direction, affinity or widget insertion selection kind; the checkpoint fails.

guards.title: Pending mark lifetime
guards.negativeControl: Swap null and explicit empty marks or leak an override across selection movement.

guards.title: Composition ownership
guards.negativeControl: Commit Enter must not split; the next deliberate Enter must split.

guards.title: UTF-16 and grapheme boundaries
guards.negativeControl: Move range inside a surrogate or delete half a grapheme; exact vector comparison fails.

guards.title: Origin and undo boundaries
guards.negativeControl: Merge one-character paste into typing or undo a remote edit; history checkpoints fail.

guards.title: Notification isolation
guards.negativeControl: Throw or request a command during notification; no rollback, duplicate update or reentrant write.

guards.title: Renderer echo ownership
guards.negativeControl: Renderer echo and genuine input in one turn must retain only the genuine new intent.

guards.title: Normalization termination
guards.negativeControl: Oscillating repair rules exceed a bounded fixed-point check and fail with a minimal trace.

guards.title: Async target and lifetime
guards.negativeControl: Late completion after target/session disposal cannot edit or refocus another target.

guards.title: Nested event ownership
guards.negativeControl: An inner input consumes clipboard events while the outer document remains unchanged.

guards.title: Stable identity across view changes
guards.negativeControl: Change presenter tag then type sentinel; original identity and mapping survive.

guards.title: Independent evidence
guards.negativeControl: Alter expected snapshot/count/source revision or remove a required case; qualification fails.
